name: PALE REPUBLIC: Collaborative World-Build
subcategory: persistent neural world / collaborative fiction / sandbox
description: The oldest continuously running BCI-integrated collaborative world in GLMZ — a persistent neural sim that has been running since 2183, now spanning 40 years of accumulated player-built civilization, culture, and history entirely independent of the real world. PALE REPUBLIC began as an experiment by the pre-corponation Meridian University neural arts program; the university was absorbed and dissolved in 2201, but the world continued running on distributed player-maintained servers. An estimated 200,000 players maintain active characters with histories spanning decades of in-world time.
story_hooks: A character in PALE REPUBLIC has been running continuously since 2183 — longer than any human could maintain a single player — and no one can determine who or what is controlling it.

A corponation has quietly purchased the server infrastructure PALE REPUBLIC runs on and is now legally its landlord; the player governance council has 90 days to find alternatives or lose 40 years of civilization.
Something encoded in PALE REPUBLIC's oldest map data — placed there by the original university developers — turns out to be a message intended to be found only after the university was gone.
